verdict.rationale: Undermind is a SaaS research product with an agent-facing surface, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair axis. Direct probes show https://undermind.ai/llms.txt and the Markdown docs variant (/mcp.md) both return 404. The documented MCP server is a separate, adjacent capability and does not count as agent-readable docs, so no evidence shows the product delivers this story.
